abilities._comment: When this hits a hero, banish the top card of their deck and up to 1 card in their arsenal. 'Up to 1' is optional and BANISHES (not destroys); the attacker chooses. Was DESTROY_ARSENAL, which destroyed every arsenal card. Contract keyword / Silver-on-completion not modeled here.

_comment: Added the missing ATTACK_TARGET_IS_HERO gate: the DSL ON_HIT listener is wired to the generic 'hit' event, which fires for ANY damaged target, and ON_ATTACK fires on declaration whatever was attacked -- so 'when this hits/attacks A HERO' also fired against allies and permanents.
